name: Amamiya Kaname
source:
"But I haven't decided on the next live song yet."

High school 3rd-year.

She is in charge of the bass in the light music club. She is a gentle girl who likes cute things. Everyone considers her to be an older sister, but she has a habit of being made fun of.

[Translated from [url=https://d10rama.com/nitousei/]official website[/url]]
